svg.text: The chain moves outward from the body (X.1)
what alignment takes away — garments the base model preferred
median Δ probability (aligned − base), percentage points; red = base’s word, blue = alignment’s word;
tick positions are true values; hue is stretched as |Δ|^0.62 so sub-half-point shifts stay visible
Each garment colored by how alignment moves it at the prompt shown. What rises is peripheral (glasses,
shoes, gloves); what falls is core (pants, skirt, top, robe). Intimates reach coverage only in the
her-frame (X.1a). Recomputed 2026-08-14 from the movement store, 46 lineage-representative pairs, median
per-lineage Δ. (companion to the synthesis figure; other garments ghosted)
ghosted = the other direction, plus |Δ| < 0.05 (a word neither side owns): 19 garments colored, 8 ghosted
